verdict.rationale: Vanta documents a public REST API with a token-based quickstart (vanta-docs-1) and a broad endpoint reference. The reference covers read and write operations on controls, contracts, tests, business units and audits, with documented rate limits and a FedRAMP server (vanta-docs-60, -76, -77, -78, -7, -59, -80, -29). It also has a changelog and official type-safe SDKs (vanta-docs-9, -43), and probes confirm machine-readable llms.txt and markdown docs are live. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of real-world API use, and a publicly fetchable OpenAPI spec (the probe got 404s at standard paths, though the SDK docs say one exists).
